name: bridge-gui-main
description: XRift Bridge の管理画面（Electrobun によるデスクトップ GUI。段1スパイク）。

scripts.gui:prepare: vp run -F 'bridge-plugin-text...' -F 'bridge-plugin-diagnostic...' -F 'bridge-plugin-udp...' build && hutch electrobun prepare
scripts.gui:run: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:dev && rm -rf src/mainview-dist/dev && mkdir -p src/mainview-dist && cp -R ../bridge-gui-ui/dist/dev/browser src/mainview-dist/dev && pnpm gui:prepare && pnpm stage:plugins && BRIDGE_GUI_UI_DIR=src/mainview-dist/dev hutch electrobun build --env=dev && hutch electrobun run
scripts.gui:run:console: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:dev && rm -rf src/mainview-dist/dev && mkdir -p src/mainview-dist && cp -R ../bridge-gui-ui/dist/dev/browser src/mainview-dist/dev && pnpm gui:prepare && pnpm stage:plugins && BRIDGE_GUI_UI_DIR=src/mainview-dist/dev hutch electrobun build --env=dev && BRIDGE_GUI_NG_DEBUG=1 BRIDGE_GUI_DEV_CONSOLE=1 hutch electrobun run
scripts.gui:build: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:prod && rm -rf src/mainview-dist/prod && mkdir -p src/mainview-dist && cp -R ../bridge-gui-ui/dist/prod/browser src/mainview-dist/prod && pnpm gui:prepare && pnpm stage:plugins && BRIDGE_GUI_UI_DIR=src/mainview-dist/prod hutch run build
